weakness: Shared door and website logins; no account procedure, approvals, or reviews; stale account; web designer held patron export rights
remediation_plan: Named door logins without refund rights; named website logins; onboarding and last-day checklist; monthly account check including API tokens
milestones: 2026-07-21 former account disabled; 2026-08-12 designer export rights removed; 2026-09-30 named logins and checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly check recorded

weakness: No time limit to disable access; shared secrets not changed at departure; no confidentiality reminder
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-001) covering ticketing, website, suite, Wi-Fi password, and a signed confidentiality reminder

weakness: No MFA on ticketing accounts, the website administrator login, the backup console, or the firewall management login
remediation_plan: Enforce the ticketing platform's MFA for all venue users; MFA on named website logins; MSP enables MFA on the backup console and firewall and sends screenshots
milestones: 2026-09-15 ticketing and website MFA on; 2026-09-30 MSP evidence received
resources_required: No cost (vendor features); MSP labor in contract

weakness: Shared passwords never changed; door password written at the door box office; no lost-password procedure; tablets without passcodes
remediation_plan: Remove the password card; passcodes on tablets; new staff Wi-Fi password each season and on departures; lost-password steps in POL-02
milestones: 2026-08-12 password card removed; 2026-09-30 tablets and Wi-Fi done

weakness: No security or privacy training for employees; no reader or card handling briefing for contractor leads
remediation_plan: Annual online training; quarterly phishing simulations; season briefing on card readers and never taking card numbers for door and bar leads
milestones: 2026-09-30 season briefing; 2026-10-31 first annual training; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: No review of ticketing, suite, or website logs
remediation_plan: Weekly 20-minute check with a checklist (exports, refunds, new users, settings, API tokens, suite sign-ins, website changes); monthly export of the ticketing audit log
milestones: 2026-10-05 first weekly check; 2026-10-31 first monthly export
resources_required: Venue Manager time (20 minutes a week)

weakness: No inventory of card readers, tablets, scanners, SaaS services, API tokens, or website scripts
remediation_plan: One-page inventory per POL-04 4.5 with reader serial numbers; pre-show reader inspection checklist
milestones: 2026-07-22 spare reader locked in the safe; 2026-09-30 inventory and checklist in use

weakness: Nothing detects changes to the website pages that host the checkout widget; unapproved scripts appear unnoticed
remediation_plan: Remove scripts not needed on event pages (including the new sponsor tag); approved script list; weekly page comparison by the web designer; website change alerts; or link to vendor-hosted event pages
milestones: 2026-09-15 scripts removed; 2026-09-30 weekly check and alerts running
resources_required: Web designer time (about $150 a month, fictional)

weakness: Flat staff network: the back-office PC, door tablets, bar POS, laptops, and touring crews can reach each other
remediation_plan: Separate staff network for office computers and door tablets; crew Wi-Fi internet-only; firewall log alerts from the MSP

weakness: Shared mailboxes not backed up; no restore test; backup console without MFA; ticketing settings not documented
remediation_plan: Add shared mailboxes to the backup; MFA on the console (POAM-003); quarterly restore test; export ticketing settings and website script list monthly
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-10-31 shared mailboxes added

weakness: Staff and contractors do not know how or when to report incidents; acquirer notice term unknown
remediation_plan: Reporting rule (POL-03 4.2) on a card at the door box office, bar, and back office; covered in the season briefing and annual training

weakness: No service provider list or requirements; payment partner AOC missing; no web designer terms; forgotten integration sending patron data
remediation_plan: Revoke the old token (done 2026-08-12) and get written deletion from the former service; service provider list; payment partner AOC; web designer and MSP contract terms for security and 72-hour incident notice
milestones: 2026-08-12 token revoked; 2026-09-30 deletion confirmation and AOC; 2026-10-31 provider list; 2026-12-31 contract terms

weakness: Card data kept in email and on paper; patron exports kept on laptops indefinitely
remediation_plan: No card data rule (POL-04 4.2) with auto-reply; exports only to the restricted folder and deleted within 30 days; laptop download folders cleaned; Owner's laptop encrypted
milestones: 2026-08-03 emails purged and forms shredded; 2026-09-15 auto-reply live; 2026-10-31 laptops cleaned and encrypted
